# Examples (outputs are real output of `scripts/iw.py`, regenerated by `dev/make_examples.py`)

These are **examples of the interface, not results of any evaluation case**.

| folder | input | what it shows |
|---|---|---|
| `landslide/` | `library.bib`: 9 REAL public arXiv records (metadata CC0) with their abstracts; `own.md`: an INVENTED paper (LiteSlide) with a method, results, Table 1 and Figure 3; `decisions.txt` (ledger blocks); `draft_v1.md` (a draft with typical defects), `draft.md` (the repaired draft) | `run.txt`: `run` (evidence brief), `ingest`, `check` on `draft_v1.md` (generic opening, a wrong number, an overstated "solves", a sequential summary, a gap that cites nothing, an invented number and an unanchored "first" in the contributions: 5 errors), `check` on `draft.md` (no error, one honest warning: a recent library entry left uncited), `build`. `out/`: `intro.md` / `intro.tex`, `references.ieee.txt`, `evidence_table.csv` (every cited clause with its status, overlap and closest source passage), `traceability.md` (gap -> cited limitations, contribution -> own evidence), `review_checklist.md`, `result.json`, `brief.md` |
| `zh/` | `case.json` with inline records (4 invented Chinese references with abstracts), task text ("约250字 ... GB/T 7714-2015") and the own material as a text field; `decisions.txt`, `draft.md` | the Chinese path: filler lexicon, numbers next to Chinese characters, GB/T 7714 numbering and type marks |

Reproduce: `python3 scripts/iw.py run --own examples/landslide/own.md --lib examples/landslide/library.bib --out /tmp/out`, then `ingest /tmp/out/.work examples/landslide/decisions.txt`, `check /tmp/out/.work examples/landslide/draft.md`, `build /tmp/out/.work examples/landslide/draft.md --out /tmp/out`.
